games.name: Paint and Seek! 🎨
games.desc:
🎨 Paint & Seek!

Blend in, hide smart, and survive the seekers! In this hide-and-seek game, painters can paint over their characters to match walls, floors, furniture, and the environment around them. Use your colors wisely, disguise yourself, and become almost invisible before the seekers find you! 👀

🏃 Hiders: Paint yourself, blend into the map, and stay hidden until time runs out.
🔎 Seekers: Search carefully, spot suspicious shapes, and catch every hidden player.
🎨 Paint System: Change your look by painting your character to match the room.
🧠 Strategy: The better you blend, the harder you are to find!

Can you become the ultimate camouflage master? 🌈
